Good questions

Wear one patch for up to eight hours, then remove it gently. Always follow the directions on your pack.

Use only as directed on the pouch. Give your skin a break between patches and avoid applying to the same spot repeatedly.

Patch test first if your skin is sensitive. Stop using immediately if irritation occurs, and speak to a healthcare professional if you are unsure.

Our formulas bring together familiar botanical ingredients including menthol, arnica, turmeric and eucalyptus. Check each pack for its complete ingredient list.

We ship across Europe. Delivery options and timing are shown before checkout, based on your destination.
